sentence: If I ______ more time, I would travel the world. (second conditional)
explanation: Segunda condicional: If + pasado simple. <If I had> expresa una situación irreal en el presente.

sentence: The report ______ by the manager yesterday. (passive voice)
explanation: Voz pasiva en pasado simple: <was/were> + participio pasado: <was written>.

sentence: She suggested ______ to the new restaurant. (gerund or infinitive)
explanation: Después de <suggest>, se usa el gerundio (forma -ing): <suggested going>.

sentence: He promised ______ me with the project. (gerund or infinitive)
explanation: Después de <promise>, se usa el infinitivo: <promised to help>.

sentence: The meeting was ______ until next Monday. (phrasal verb: postpone)
explanation: El phrasal verb <put off> significa posponer o aplazar.

sentence: She ______ the problem after hours of work. (phrasal verb: solve)
explanation: El phrasal verb <figure out> significa resolver o entender algo.

sentence: We need to ______ a solution before the deadline. (phrasal verb: think of)
explanation: El phrasal verb <come up with> significa pensar en o producir una idea.

sentence: He ______ his father. They look exactly the same. (phrasal verb: resemble)
explanation: El phrasal verb <take after> significa parecerse a un familiar.

sentence: Don't ______ the opportunity to study abroad. (phrasal verb: miss)
explanation: El phrasal verb <pass up> significa perder o no aprovechar una oportunidad.

sentence: The whole project was a wild goose chase. This means it was a ______ effort.
explanation: El modismo <a wild goose chase> significa una búsqueda inútil o infructuosa.

sentence: She spilled the beans about the surprise party. She ______ the secret.
explanation: El modismo <spill the beans> significa revelar un secreto.

sentence: He's been burning the midnight oil. He's been ______ very late.
explanation: El modismo <burn the midnight oil> significa trabajar o estudiar hasta muy tarde.

sentence: Don't beat around the bush. Just say it ______.
explanation: El modismo <beat around the bush> significa evitar decir algo directamente.

sentence: She's on the ball. She's very ______ and efficient.
explanation: El modismo <on the ball> significa estar alerta, ser competente y actuar con rapidez.

sentence: It cost an arm and a leg. It was very ______.
explanation: El modismo <cost an arm and a leg> significa que algo es muy caro.

sentence: The develop______ of the new software took six months.
explanation: Al agregar <-ment> a <develop> se forma el sustantivo <development>.

sentence: Her kind______ made everyone feel welcome.
explanation: Al agregar <-ness> a <kind> se forma el sustantivo <kindness>.

sentence: The ______ of the word 'un-' means 'not'. (prefix meaning)
explanation: Un <prefix> se agrega al principio de una palabra para cambiar su significado.

sentence: Adding 're-' to 'write' gives us ______, meaning to write again.
explanation: El prefijo <re-> significa 'otra vez': <rewrite> = escribir de nuevo.

sentence: If she studied harder, she ______ pass the exam. (transform to conditional)
explanation: Cláusula de resultado de la segunda condicional: <would> + forma base.
